svg.title: scan_view timing, trigger=sim
svg.text: 1. Normal: A is on C1 (the master), B on C2. 20 pulses, 26 ms apart.
num_pulses = 20 edges, pulse_interval_ms = 26 apart (each edge: a fixed 5 us ESP32 pulse)
A's pulses: width_us = 12 ms each (RP2350 PIO)
edges counted, no pulse (not its filament)
Both RP2350s walk the same table: each edge fires a pulse only on the board whose filament's row is released; the other counts it.
From A's first edge, the RP2350s time every gap against trigger_timeout_ms (sim default 2 x 26 + 100 = 152 ms).
2. A's window ends mid-train (edges 200 ms apart): the rest of the train is still coming.
A's leftover edges fire B: wrong count, wrong timing
the 1 edge before the stop lands on no released row: dropped and counted; none after it
